pull.title: rpc: Use self.Arg<_>(name) helper over manual and duplicate parsing
pull.body:
The `Arg()` helper has many benefits:

* It does not require manual `isNull` checks
* It does not require hard-coding the fallback/default value a second time
* It does not require manually specifying the getter for the type. Specifying the type is enough.

So use it more broadly.

comments.body: nit: commit message states "The test is modified to show the second legacy alias is ignored." but that's not true, unless we do something like `BOOST_CHECK_THROW(self.Arg<bool>("legacy_def_bool"), NonFatalCheckError);` - which I think we should if only allowing the first name is intentional (cfr [this comment](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36384/changes#paneldiscussion_r4467230472))

nit: people might be tempted to "upgrade" this to accept aliases too (I spent a few cycles thinking about it), so perhaps worth briefly documenting why we only accept first name here?

<details>
<summary>git diff on fada6e1dcb</summary>

```diff
diff --git a/src/rpc/util.cpp b/src/rpc/util.cpp
index 2c7f6a96ee..e2cf363a97 100644
--- a/src/rpc/util.cpp
+++ b/src/rpc/util.cpp
@@ -771,6 +771,7 @@ std::vector<std::pair<std::string, bool>> RPCMethod::GetArgNames() const
 
 size_t RPCMethod::GetParamIndex(std::string_view key) const
 {
+    // Use only the first name, so that callers are uniform and legacy aliases can be removed.
     auto it{std::ranges::find_if(m_args, [&key](const auto& arg) { return arg.GetFirstName() == key; })};
 
     CHECK_NONFATAL(it != m_args.end());  // TODO: ideally this is checked at compile time

```
</details>
Hmm, this may change the parsing order, so I think I'll leave this as-is for now to keep it a "refactor" that is easy to review.
